_comment: Known Ad Service incidents: the planted bugs documented in src/flagd/demo.flagd.json (yeet302/RAG-to-Riches @ 4a70112) and the team's planted-bug tests. The home page lists these; live status comes from Log Analytics (each bug logs its own inject:* tag). Edit this file to add or change incidents.

incidents.title: GetAds requests fail with UNAVAILABLE
incidents.symptom: GetAds returns gRPC UNAVAILABLE, so ads fail to load and the frontend proxy returns HTTP 500.
incidents.question: Why are GetAds requests failing with UNAVAILABLE errors in the Ad Service?

incidents.title: Targeted ad requests fail
incidents.symptom: GetAds requests with context keys (for example binoculars or travel) fail with UNAVAILABLE, while untargeted ads still load.
incidents.question: Why are targeted ad requests failing in the Ad Service, especially requests for binoculars?

incidents.title: High CPU in the Ad Service
incidents.symptom: Extra CPU load runs on every GetAds request while the flag is on, raising CPU use and ad latency.
incidents.question: What could cause unusually high CPU usage in the Ad Service?

incidents.title: Ad Service returns empty ad responses
incidents.symptom: GetAds succeeds but returns an empty AdResponse, so no ads are shown and no request fails.
incidents.question: Why is the Ad Service returning an empty AdResponse instead of advertisements?

incidents.title: Long pauses during GetAds calls
incidents.symptom: GetAds triggers full manual garbage collections, so some ad requests pause for a long time.
incidents.question: Why does the Ad Service have occasional long pauses during GetAds calls?
